hook: A Rust engine claiming 4.5x llama.cpp's speed.

beats.say: Velocity Research released Kinetic, an open-source Rust engine that runs GGUF models on CPUs and on NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs.
One posted benchmark, on a laptop with a Ryzen 5 6600H and an RTX 3060 with six gigabytes, shows 1,033 tokens per second against llama.cpp's 230.
The authors promise its speed-ups never change the output. These are the authors' own published numbers.
